The final output literally ends mid-sentence with 'The investigation has definitively shown:'. The agent's approach was also inefficient, spending too much time on repetitive grep/sed searches through a 2M-line log file rather than using more targeted extraction strategies. While the investigative direction was largely correct, an incomplete answer that times out cannot score well regardless of the quality of intermediate findings.
